newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia palm olein stable in late trade.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia palm olein stable in late trade.

text.p: Indonesian palm olein prices were mostly stable in late trading on Friday but buying interest was thin ahead of the weekend, traders said.
They said olein was quoted at 1,435-40 rupiah/kg in Jakarta, but offers were also heard at 1,430 rupiah. Crude palm oil was on offer at around 1,220 rupiah/kg in Medan.
"There was not much activity, with buyers mostly staying sidelined ahead of the weekend," one trader said.
"I heard that crude palm oil exports have been rising because of the good export price and ahead of an expected increase in the export tax next month," he said.
